correctness.rationale: Uniform labeled chord sampling proves model equivalence; conditional integral identities (means 1/3, conditional second moments 2/15, mixed 1/9) establish zero shared-pair cross covariances. Same-pair contribution -1/9 produces exact covariance; equal-type shared covariances 1/45 give exact variances. Bounded degenerate order-two remainders have variance O(n^2), while iid projection vectors obey a bivariate CLT with diagonal covariance 1/45. Exact rational exhaustive verification through six chords supplies independent finite checks; no finite check is treated as proof of limits.

value.rationale: The same two chord patterns are mutually exclusive locally, so they could plausibly stay dependent globally. A surprising exact orthogonality of their one-chord conditional influences forces a joint independent Gaussian limit despite finite negative covariance. This gives a structural second-order dependence law beyond known marginal variances and marginal CLTs, relevant to joint inference about two natural random-matching statistics; it is not a parameter tweak or the reproof of an existing marginal theorem.
